environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) behind an Application Load Balancer with public-facing listener on port 443. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No CloudFront distribution configured. ALB forwards directly to target group on port 8080. Instance runs Python 3.9 with CPython runtime (ctypes memory operations are real). No request signing or authentication middleware.
